name: Festtage 2026
description: Created in 1996, this mini festival celebrates the Easter season by providing a wide and extensive programme of operatic gems. Highlights include Richard Strauss' The Rose Cavalier, directed by André Heller, which will be put on three times. Plus Nikola Hillebrand and Samuel Hasselhorn will perform in the Festtage concert with the Staatskapelle Berlin under the musical direction of Christian Thielemann.
